description: This file implements an audio resampler class using the SoX ResampleStream library, designed for high-quality, real-time audio sample rate conversion for mono PCM audio streams.

classes.name: SOXRStreamAudioResampler
classes.description: An audio resampler class utilizing the SoX ResampleStream library for high-quality sample rate conversion, supporting real-time streaming and chunk processing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the resampler with optional keyword arguments.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Sets up the internal SoX ResampleStream with specified input and output sample rates.

methods.name: _maybe_clear_internal_state
methods.description: Clears the internal resampling state if a specified timeout has passed since last resampling.

methods.name: _maybe_initialize_sox_stream
methods.description: Ensures the SoX stream is initialized with the correct sample rates, reinitializing if necessary.

methods.name: resample
methods.description: Performs resampling of input audio bytes from in_rate to out_rate using the SoX ResampleStream library.
